info.name: SAP BAPI Collection
info.description: A collection to call SAP BAPIs via SOAP Web Services.

body.raw:
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:urn="urn:sap-com:document:sap:rfc:functions">
   <soapenv:Header/>
   <soapenv:Body>
      <urn:BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST>
         <DOCUMENTHEADER>
            <OBJ_TYPE>IDOC</OBJ_TYPE>
            <USERNAME>{{sap-username}}</USERNAME>
            <HEADER_TXT>POSTMAN TEST</HEADER_TXT>
            <COMP_CODE>1000</COMP_CODE>
            <DOC_DATE>2023-10-27</DOC_DATE>
            <PSTNG_DATE>2023-10-27</PSTNG_DATE>
            <DOC_TYPE>SA</DOC_TYPE>
            <REF_DOC_NO>POSTMAN001</REF_DOC_NO>
         </DOCUMENTHEADER>
         <ACCOUNTGL>
            <!-- Debit Line Item -->
            <item>
               <ITEMNO_ACC>0000000001</ITEMNO_ACC>
               <GL_ACCOUNT>0000400000</GL_ACCOUNT>
               <ITEM_TEXT>Debit Entry</ITEM_TEXT>
               <COMP_CODE>1000</COMP_CODE>
            </item>
            <!-- Credit Line Item -->
            <item>
               <ITEMNO_ACC>0000000002</ITEMNO_ACC>
               <GL_ACCOUNT>0000100000</GL_ACCOUNT>
               <ITEM_TEXT>Credit Entry</ITEM_TEXT>
               <COMP_CODE>1000</COMP_CODE>
            </item>
         </ACCOUNTGL>
         <CURRENCYAMOUNT>
            <!-- Debit Amount -->
            <item>
               <ITEMNO_ACC>0000000001</ITEMNO_ACC>
               <CURRENCY>USD</CURRENCY>
               <AMT_DOCCUR>100.00</AMT_DOCCUR>
            </item>
            <!-- Credit Amount (Note the negative sign) -->
            <item>
               <ITEMNO_ACC>0000000002</ITEMNO_ACC>
               <CURRENCY>USD</CURRENCY>
               <AMT_DOCCUR>-100.00</AMT_DOCCUR>
            </item>
         </CURRENCYAMOUNT>
      </urn:BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST>
   </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>

request.description: Posts an accounting document to SAP using BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST. Requires the BAPI to be exposed as a SOAP web service via SOAMANAGER.
